units.source_text: 霰雪飘零之时，到处风声凄厉。

en.t: When sleet and snow drifted down, the wind sounded bitter and desolate everywhere.

units.source_text: 两女公子似觉这山居生涯是现在才开始的。

en.t: The two princesses felt as though their life in the mountain dwelling had only now truly begun.

units.source_text: 侍女中有几个精神振作的人对两女公子说：“唉，这晦气的年头即将过完了。

en.t: A few of the more spirited women among the attendants said to the two princesses, "Ah, this unlucky year is nearly over.

units.source_text: 小姐快把过去的悲伤收拾起来，欢欢喜喜地迎接新春吧。”

en.t: My ladies, put away the sorrows of the past and welcome the New Year with glad hearts."

units.source_text: 小姐想道：“这真是难事了。”

en.t: The young ladies thought, "That is truly a difficult thing to do."

units.source_text: 八亲王生前常常闭居在山寺中念佛，故当时山上也常有法师等来访。

en.t: During his lifetime, Prince Hachi had often secluded himself in a mountain temple to chant the Buddha's name, so monks and others frequently came to the mountain then.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨也挂念两位女公子，有时派人前来问候。

en.t: The ajari also worried about the two princesses and sometimes sent people to ask after them.

units.source_text: 但现在八亲王已不在世，他自己也不便亲到。

en.t: But now that Prince Hachi was no longer alive, it was awkward for him to come in person.

units.source_text: 山庄里人影逐渐稀少，两女公子知道这原是当然之事，然而不胜悲伤。

en.t: People gradually grew fewer at the mountain villa; the two princesses knew this was only natural, yet they could not bear the sadness of it.

units.source_text: 八亲王不在后，有些毫不足道的山农野老，有时也走进这山庄里来探望。

en.t: After Prince Hachi was gone, even insignificant mountain farmers and old villagers sometimes came into the villa to pay their respects.

units.source_text: 众侍女难得看到这种人，都觉得稀罕。

en.t: The attendants rarely saw such people and all found them unusual.

units.source_text: 时值秋季，也有些山民樵些木柴、拾些果实，送到山庄里来。

en.t: As it was autumn, some mountain villagers cut firewood and gathered fruit, then brought them to the villa.

units.source_text: 阿阇梨的山寺中，派法师送来木炭等物，并致词云：“多年以来，岁暮必致送微物，习以为常。

en.t: From the ajari's mountain temple, a monk was sent with charcoal and other things, along with the message, "For many years it has been our custom to send a small gift at year's end.

units.source_text: 今年如果断绝，于心有所不忍，故照旧例，务请赏收。”

en.t: If we let the practice lapse this year, our hearts could not bear it, so we have followed the old custom; please be so kind as to accept it."

units.source_text: 两女公子想起：过去每逢岁暮，此间亦必送绵衣去，以供阿阇梨闭居山寺时御寒之用，便用绵衣回敬他。

en.t: The two princesses remembered that in the past, at every year end, they too had sent padded robes for the ajari to use against the cold while secluded in the mountain temple, so they returned his gift with padded robes.

units.source_text: 法师偕童子辞了山庄，在很深的雪中登山回寺，忽隐忽现。

en.t: The monk and his acolyte took leave of the villa and climbed back through the deep snow toward the temple, appearing and disappearing from view.

units.source_text: 两女公子流着眼泪目送他们。

en.t: The two princesses watched them go with tears in their eyes.

units.source_text: 相与言道：“即使父亲削发为僧，只要活在世间，这样来来往往的人也自然会很多。

en.t: They said to each other, "Even if our father had shaved his head and become a monk, as long as he were alive in this world, there would naturally have been many people coming and going like this.

units.source_text: 我们无论何等寂寞，总不会与父亲不得见面。”

en.t: No matter how lonely we were, we would never have been unable to see our father."

units.source_text: 大女公子便吟诗曰：

en.t: The elder princess then composed a poem:
